name: Master Vidlian's Squeeze-Box
body:
Source Magical Marketplace pg. 31
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 5th
Slot none; Price 6,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This concertina was created by the notorious Chelish bard Vidlian the Reveler. It can be used like a masterwork concertina, providing a +2 bonus on Perform (keyboard instruments) checks. At any one time, Master Vidlian’s squeeze-box is either more compressed than extended or more extended than compressed, and switching between the two is a free action (and in fact, happens regularly when the instrument is played). When the concertina is compressed and held in a hand, the wielder gains the compression ability. When the concertina is extended and held in a hand, the wielder is immune to constriction damage (as from constrict attacks) and damage from being buried, although the wielder gains no protection from suffocation.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, cushioning bandsUM, grease; Cost 3,000 gp
